raw.title: The Phenomenology of Spirit
raw.description: 1807 book by Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel
raw.extract: The Phenomenology of Spirit is an 1807 book by the German philosopher Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel. It is Hegel's first major work and is considered one of the most important and difficult works of German idealism. The book describes a "biography of Spirit" in which consciousness develops from its most basic forms of sensory experience to the highest form of self-knowledge, which Hegel terms "absolute knowing". The book's central argument is that human beings achieve freedom through a process of retrospective self-understanding.
